body_markdown:
Enerflex has been awarded a major Engineered Systems project to design, engineer, fabricate, and assemble approximately 450 MW of behind-the-meter natural gas-fired power generation for a North American data center developer. The award builds on more than four decades of Enerflex power generation experience and demonstrates the Company’s capabilities in supporting the growing power requirements of data centers and digital infrastructure.


[Read Full Press Release](https://investors.enerflex.com/node/7916/pdf)
